abstract: The Current Biology primer on Human-wildlife conflict by Kaitlyn Gaynor and Jennifer Green1 has many strengths. We agree with much of the content but highlight omissions of some important alternative hypotheses and worldviews. We call attention to a worldview that individual non-humans deserve consideration neglected in the primer. Also, we call attention to omissions of alternative hypotheses and fore-grounding a non-leading hypothesis about tolerance for wildlife. The improvements to the primer we suggest would enhance the inclusivity of work on human-wildlife conflicts and also recognize the plurality of the scientific community. Therefore, we offer this letter to advance public understanding of coexistence with wildlife and place research on such topics on a firmer scientific footing.
